data.summary_en: EvoSkill v2 improves skill evolution: bash-equipped stateful coding evolver throughout, not a single model call or per-round-restarted agent, accepts each epoch's skills. On SpreadsheetBench v2 and τ^3-bench banking, skills raise held-out pass rates over the stronger of SkillOpt/SkillBoost by 7.7 and 5.4 percentage points, respectively.
